```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read_csv("/Users/xiaoyuzhou/Desktop/Doodling Result.csv")

answer_key <- read_excel("/Users/xiaoyuzhou/Desktop/recall_answer_key.xlsx")

head(df)

print(df)

colnames(df)
```

```{r pivot-longer}

# pivot longer 

long_df <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(visual|audio)_\\d+$"),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TaskType = if_else(str_starts(item, "visual_"), "Visual", "Auditory"),
    QuestionNum = as.integer(str_extract(item, "\\d+")),
    PassageIndex = ceiling(QuestionNum / 4),  # 1-4 => passage 1; 5-8 => passage 2; 9-12 => passage 3
    ConditionGroup = if_else(TaskType == "Visual", visual_condition, auditory_condition),
    response = as.integer(response) # 1 = yes, 2 = no
  )

# add the passage title
long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(
    PassageName = case_when(
      TaskType == "Visual"   & PassageIndex == 1 ~ "macOS vs. Linux vs. Windows",
      TaskType == "Visual"   & PassageIndex == 2 ~ "Bash vs. Zsh",
      TaskType == "Visual"   & PassageIndex == 3 ~ "File systems",
      TaskType == "Auditory" & PassageIndex == 1 ~ "Package Managers",
      TaskType == "Auditory" & PassageIndex == 2 ~ "Security models",
      TaskType == "Auditory" & PassageIndex == 3 ~ "GUI vs. CLI",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# add doodling type 
lookup <- tribble(
  ~TaskType,   ~ConditionGroup, ~PassageIndex, ~PassageName,                          ~doodle_type,

  # Auditory
  "Auditory",  "A",            1,             "Package Managers",                   "Free",
  "Auditory",  "A",            2,             "Security models",                    "Structured",
  "Auditory",  "A",            3,             "GUI vs. CLI",                        "Control",

  "Auditory",  "B",            1,             "Package Managers",                   "Control",
  "Auditory",  "B",            2,             "Security models",                    "Free",
  "Auditory",  "B",            3,             "GUI vs. CLI",                        "Structured",

  "Auditory",  "C",            1,             "Package Managers",                   "Structured",
  "Auditory",  "C",            2,             "Security models",                    "Control",
  "Auditory",  "C",            3,             "GUI vs. CLI",                        "Free",

  "Auditory",  "D",            1,             "Pcakage Managers",                   "Free",
  "Auditory",  "D",            2,             "Security models",                    "Control",
  "Auditory",  "D",            3,             "GUI vs. CLI",                        "Structured",

  # Visual
  "Visual",    "A",            1,             "macOS vs. Linux vs. Windows",        "Free",
  "Visual",    "A",            2,             "Bash vs. Zsh",                       "Structured",
  "Visual",    "A",            3,             "File systems",                       "Control",

  "Visual",    "B",            1,             "macOS vs. Linux vs. Windows",        "Control",
  "Visual",    "B",            2,             "Bash vs. Zsh",                       "Free",
  "Visual",    "B",            3,             "File systems",                       "Structured",

  "Visual",    "C",            1,             "macOS vs. Linux vs. Windows",        "Structured",
  "Visual",    "C",            2,             "Bash vs. Zsh",                       "Control",
  "Visual",    "C",            3,             "File systems",                       "Free",

  "Visual",    "D",            1,             "macOS vs. Linux vs. Window",         "Control",
  "Visual",    "D",            2,             "File systems",                       "Free",
  "Visual",    "D",            3,             "Bash vs. Zsh",                       "Structured"
)


# join the datasets

long_df <- long_df %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = c("TaskType", "ConditionGroup","PassageIndex")) %>%
  mutate(
    doodle_type = factor(doodle_type, levels = c("Control","Free","Structured")),
    TaskType = factor(TaskType),
    p_id = factor(p_id)
  )

# join the answer key and compute accuracy
long_df <- long_df %>%
  left_join(answer_key, by = "item") %>%
  mutate(
    RecallAcc = as.integer(response == correct_answer)
  )
```


```{r}

# 1) Summarize accuracy by TaskType × doodle_type
plot_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(TaskType, doodle_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    acc = mean(RecallAcc, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sqrt(acc * (1 - acc) / n),   # binomial SE for proportions
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = doodle_type, y = acc)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = acc - se, ymax = acc + se), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ TaskType) +
  labs(
    x = "Doodling Type",
    y = "Recall Accuracy (Proportion Correct)",
    title = "Recall Accuracy by Doodling Type, Faceted by Task Type"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
```


```{r}
pp_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(p_id, TaskType, doodle_type, visual_condition) %>%
  summarise(acc = mean(RecallAcc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(pp_df, aes(x = doodle_type, y = acc, color = visual_condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ TaskType) +
  labs(
    x = "Doodling Type",
    y = "Participant Mean Recall Accuracy",
    title = "Participant-Level Recall Accuracy by Doodling Type"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
```


```{r}
pp_df %>%
  group_by(TaskType, doodle_type) %>%
  summarise(sd_acc = sd(acc))


pp_df %>%
  group_by(TaskType, doodle_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(acc))
```

- as the participants number increases the mean_acc increases and the sd decreases. 

```{r}
model1 <- glmer(RecallAcc ~ TaskType * doodle_type + (1 | p_id),
      family = binomial,
      data = long_df)

summary(model1)

model2 <- anova(RecallAcc ~ doodle_type + (1 | p_id),
      data = long_df)

summary(model2)
```

# Learner's Type 

```{r}
visual_verbal_items <- c(
   "learn_type_3", "learn_type_7", "learn_type_11", "learn_type_15",
  "learn_type_19", "learn_type_23", "learn_type_27", "learn_type_31",
  "learn_type_35", "learn_type_39", "learn_type_43")

# change the value 
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(visual_verbal_items),
      ~ case_when(
        . == 1 ~ -1,   # 1 = Visual
        . == 2 ~  1,   # 2 = Verbal
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_scored"
    )
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    visual_verbal_score = sum(c_across(ends_with("_scored")), na.rm = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(p_id = as.character(p_id)) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      mutate(p_id = as.character(p_id)) %>%
      select(p_id, visual_verbal_score),
    by = "p_id"
  )
```

# Model 2 with leraner's type
```{r}
model2 <- glmer(
  RecallAcc ~ TaskType * doodle_type * visual_verbal_score + (1 | p_id),
  family = binomial,
  data = long_df
)

print(model2)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(
    visual_verbal_c = scale(visual_verbal_score, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[,1]
  )

model3 <- glmer(
  RecallAcc ~ TaskType * doodle_type * visual_verbal_c + (1 | p_id),
  family = binomial,
  data = long_df,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
)

vv_sd <- sd(long_df$visual_verbal_c, na.rm = TRUE)

vv_vals <- c(-vv_sd, 0, vv_sd)
vv_vals


emm3 <- emmeans(
  model3,
  ~ doodle_type * TaskType | visual_verbal_c,
  at = list(visual_verbal_c = vv_vals),
  type = "response"
)

emm3_df <- as.data.frame(emm3)
emm3_df

emm3_df <- emm3_df %>%
  mutate(
    learner_group = case_when(
      visual_verbal_c == vv_vals[1] ~ "Low verbal / more visual",
      visual_verbal_c == vv_vals[2] ~ "Average",
      visual_verbal_c == vv_vals[3] ~ "High verbal / less visual"
    )
  )

ggplot(emm3_df, aes(x = doodle_type, y = prob, color = TaskType, group = TaskType)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ learner_group) +
  labs(
    x = "Doodling Type",
    y = "Predicted Recall Probability",
    color = "Task Type",
    title = "Three-Way Interaction: Task Type × Doodling Type × Learner Type"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
```


# MPI 

```{r}
# reverse code 
mpi_items <- paste0("MPI_", 1:14)

reverse_items <- c("MPI_5", "MPI_6", "MPI_8", "MPI_10", 
                   "MPI_11", "MPI_13", "MPI_14")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(reverse_items), ~ 6 - .)
  )
```


```{r}
# sum
df <- df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    MPI_score = sum(c_across(all_of(mpi_items)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# merge to long dataset 
long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(p_id = as.character(p_id)) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      mutate(p_id = as.character(p_id)) %>%
      select(p_id, MPI_score),
    by = "p_id"
  )

```


```{r}
# center the MPI score 
long_df <- long_df %>%
  mutate(
    MPI_c = scale(MPI_score, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[,1]
  )
```

```{r}
# model with MPI score 
model_mpi <- glmer(
  RecallAcc ~ TaskType * doodle_type * MPI_c + (1 | p_id),
  family = binomial,
  data = long_df
)

summary(model_mpi)
```

```{r}
# get prediction
mpi_range <- seq(min(long_df$MPI_c), max(long_df$MPI_c), length.out = 50)

emm_mpi <- emmeans(
  model_mpi,
  ~ doodle_type * TaskType | MPI_c,
  at = list(MPI_c = mpi_range),
  type = "response"
)

emm_mpi_df <- as.data.frame(emm_mpi)
```

```{r}
ggplot(emm_mpi_df, aes(x = MPI_c, y = prob, color = doodle_type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ TaskType) +
  labs(
    x = "Multitasking Preference (MPI Centered)",
    y = "Predicted Recall Probability",
    color = "Doodling Type",
    title = "Model-Predicted Interaction: MPI × Doodling × Task"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
```
